coordinates.origin: Floor contact center between the feet at (0, 0, 0).
coordinates.export_convention: Blender Z-up, -Y forward; glTF Y-up, +Z forward.

concept.reason: Retained published skeleton restoration plus same-species skull lateral and mandibular dorsal/ventral diagrams provide enough structural reference for this bounded original silhouette. New AI imagery would not improve the known anatomy. This waiver does not waive gray-model self-checks or independent visual review.

scope: Original whole-organism living reconstruction of Diatryma gigantea under the historical catalog name Gastornis, anchored to AMNH 6169 skeletal proportions and supported by same-species skull anatomy. Early Eocene Wyoming context. Not a fossil replica, scan, generic terror bird, or European Gastornis composite.

scientific_limits.en: Feather covering, color, soft-tissue thickness, eye details and pose are artistic inferences. Two metres is a rounded museum-scale estimate, not a measurement of AMNH 6169 or a claim about its sex or maturity. Same-species USGS 21862 jaw views supplement AMNH 6169, without claiming one complete individual. The 2024 Diatryma/Gastornis distinction is followed. Evidence favors herbivory, but exact foods and behavior are not established; the 1991 predatory interpretation is not adopted.
scientific_limits.zh: 羽被、颜色、软组织厚度、眼部细节和姿态为艺术推定。两米是取整的博物馆尺度估值，不是AMNH 6169实测值，亦不判断该标本的性别或成熟程度。以同种USGS 21862下颌多视图辅助AMNH 6169，不声称为单个完整个体。采用2024年Diatryma与Gastornis的区分。证据倾向植食，但具体食物和行为未定；不采用1991年的捕食解释。

name.zh: 加斯顿鸟（Diatryma gigantea，历史名称）

taxonomy_note.en: The stable catalog ID retains its historical Gastornis usage. This animal follows Diatryma gigantea, re-established within Diatryma by Mayr and colleagues (2024); it is not a reconstruction of the distinct European Gastornis laurenti or G. parisiensis.
taxonomy_note.zh: 稳定目录ID保留历史Gastornis用法。本件对应Mayr等（2024）重新承认Diatryma属下的Diatryma gigantea，不是欧洲Gastornis laurenti或G. parisiensis的复原。

geometry_targets.reason: Spend geometry on a designed deep beak profile, muscular neck transition, feathered torso, leg joints and separated toes. Ceilings are practical headroom, not targets to fill.

surface_profile.normals: Intentional mixed shading: broad controlled facets on plumage masses, clean continuous normals on beak/eyes; no accidental random noise or micro-feather geometry.

scale.basis: Rounded taxon-level exhibit scale; all soft-tissue ratios below are original modeling targets, not fossil caliper measurements.
scale.life_stage: unspecified mature-sized appearance; no specimen ontogeny claim

pose.stance: Quiet weight-bearing stand, one foot at most 0.08 m ahead of the other; neither a running gait nor attacking pose.
pose.head: Nearly level beak, neutral closed gape; no prey, vegetation prop or implied feeding event.
pose.wings: Paired very small tucked wing volumes, partly merged into shoulder plumage.
pose.tail: Short restrained feathered wedge, not a long ratite plume or dinosaur tail.

feature_obligations.required: Massive dorsoventrally deep, laterally compressed beak with a broad rising culmen and clean closed cutting seam. Terminal shape must be restrained, without a separate raptor-like hook, teeth or serrations. Beak must not become a duck bill, parrot beak or short G. laurenti-style stub.
feature_obligations.check: Side and perspective silhouette; top width versus head width.

feature_obligations.required: Large head on a visibly thick but subtly curved neck, flowing into a heavy deep torso. Keep the head high and readable without a swan-thin neck, circular sphere-stack joints or exaggerated ostrich proportions.
feature_obligations.check: Front/side and quick clay views before final rendering.

feature_obligations.required: Two strong separated legs, thick proximal thighs integrated into torso plumage, shorter robust exposed lower legs and readable ankle joints; feet remain grounded.
feature_obligations.check: Front negative space and side contact; no sprinting leg exaggeration.

feature_obligations.required: Each foot has three separated forward weight-bearing toes with restrained rounded nails and a much smaller posterior hallux. Do not add grasping raptor talons. Exact nail outline and hallux soft tissues are inferred, not trackmaker-certified.
feature_obligations.check: Top and front silhouette, no fused fan/slab toes or floating contacts.

feature_obligations.required: Tiny tucked wings and short tail remain distinct from the torso when viewed obliquely; no flight feather fan, huge wings, decorative crest or cassowary casque.
feature_obligations.check: Perspective and top, with controlled asymmetric feather edge design only.

feature_obligations.required: Use custom profile/loft surfaces and deliberate cross-section changes. Primary masses must blend visually into an authored silhouette; do not deliver untouched low-resolution UV spheres, visible cylinders, triangulated blobs, random spike feathers or eyes pasted far outside the skull.
feature_obligations.check: Independent actual-GLB image review at thumbnail and full size.

view_plan.background: Transparent or neutral as declared by actual renderer.

website_render_plan.reuse_512_policy: Do not claim website-compliant preview until the actual current renderer, camera and configuration hashes are verified. Default canonical perspective is retained for independent review; reuse is allowed only if exact contract and diagnostic coverage are both demonstrated.

acceptance_boundaries.maker: Build, exact-export evidence and technical tests only; leave independent status PENDING.
acceptance_boundaries.reviewer: Fresh independent exact-byte factual and visual review; verify real identity separation.
acceptance_boundaries.runtime: GPU and populated-scene checks remain UNKNOWN unless actually run and evidenced.
acceptance_boundaries.publication: No publication, merge, deployment or user acceptance implied by preparation or local QA.

required_build_evidence: Pinned actual Blender/exporter version, deterministic seed and relative dependencies
Early 3-view clay inspection before final renders
Standalone exact GLB, editable blend, source and parameters
Official glTF validation and scoped geometry tests
Two isolated actual rebuilds with normalized geometry/material comparison
Four final exact-GLB views with hashes
Fresh independent review and complete fixed manifest
Actual-reader preflight after independent PASS, not during preparation
